title: Vikram and Betal: The Clever Farmer

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a farmer.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram a story about a poor but honest farmer.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The farmer finds gold and returns it.
scenes.text: The farmer found gold coins and returned them to a merchant.
scenes.image_prompt: farmer handing gold bag to merchant cartoon

scenes.text: The merchant accused the farmer of stealing some coins.
The king asked the merchant about the exact number of coins.
scenes.image_prompt: king questioning merchant in court cartoon

scenes.summary: Truth is revealed and justice is done.
scenes.text: The merchant could not answer, and the farmer was rewarded for honesty.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding farmer while merchant looks ashamed cartoon

story: A farmer found gold and returned it, but a merchant falsely accused him. The king tested the merchant and revealed the truth. The honest farmer was rewarded, and Vikram answered Betal wisely.
